notes:
Reached tjmaxx.tjx.com via curl_cffi impersonate=safari17_2_ios (per notes/71.md precedent; plain requests/Akamai-standard UA gets a 403 securityfailover page). Fetched the site's full sitewide navMenuData.jsp (navigationHierarchy, itemCount per node) and searched the whole tree case-insensitively for 'pet'. Found exactly one genuine Pet Care node: Home > Shop by Category > pet (itemCount=222, node N-1120695386), a flat leaf with no child categories -- structurally identical to the Marshalls 'Pet' department precedent (SR24, qty 226) on the same TJX/Endeca platform. Also found 'pet' nodes under 'new arrivals > home > shop by category' (itemCount=33) and 'clearance > home > shop by category' (itemCount=11) and under 'clearance' top-level -- these are marketing/state re-cuts (New Arrivals, Clearance) of the same underlying pet catalog, not separate categories; dropped per brief Section 3 (navigation/marketing pages are never a category) and Section 4 (same-underlying-listing merge rule -- items already counted in the base 'pet' node). Checked Home > Shop by Room (bathroom/bedroom/kitchen & dining room/living room) and Gifts (gifts for her/him/kids/home, gift shops, by occasion, by price) -- no pet-specific node found in either branch. Fetched the live desktop category page (https://tjmaxx.tjx.com/store/shop/home-shop-by-category-pet/_/N-1120695386, HTTP 200,

pet

) and three-way validated qty: navMenuData.jsp itemCount=222, the same page's own embedded nav JSON itemCount=222 for node N-1120695386, and the rendered on-page header 'resultsCountHeader category__count' = '222 items' -- all three agree. Sampled 171 unique product-URL slugs rendered on that page (e.g. Marble-Pet-Bowl, 15in-Sunny-Octopus-Pet-Toy, Classic-Large-Dog-Blanket, Deer-Print-Ultra-Plush-Cuddler-Pet-Bed, Cat-Head-Pet-Hut, 24x18-Wavy-Striped-Pet-Feeding-Mat, Lobster-Pet-Costume) confirming genuine pet products (bowls, toys, beds, scratchers, feeding mats, costumes, blankets) -- no pet food/consumable or medical/veterinary items observed in the sample, so no MANUAL REVIEW flag needed for those open policy gaps. Site has only this single flat 'pet' leaf -- no sub-category breakdown (no Pet > Beds / Pet > Toys / Pet > Feeding split) exists anywhere in the nav tree or in the page's own category-filter dropdown (which lists only sibling top-level categories, not pet sub-facets), so this is emitted as one non-group row, not a grouping row with children.
